name: Pass On
source:
Your life with your star-loving wife is everything you ever wanted. She wants more, and then everything falls apart. Now you must decide: hold on to the past or stand by your convictions. Will your feelings for her sway you?

[From [url=https://jploia.itch.io/pass-on]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与热爱明星的妻子一起生活就是你想要的一切。她想要更多，然后一切都崩溃了。现在你必须做出决定：坚持过去还是坚持你的信念。你对她的感情会影响你吗？

[来自[url=https://jploia.itch.io/pass-on]Itch.io[/url]]
